messages:
maria_support: Heads-up: SupplyChain Inc reported invoice INV-9443 paid but missing their PO number (PO-7712). Payment posted yesterday and shows as 'succeeded' in ledger. Customer needs a reissued invoice for AP. Ticket #2345: https://tickets.example/2345 — can finance/billing advise on reissue + credit workflow?

priya_finance: Thanks — quick Q: payment method? If it was card we may need refund+rebill; if ACH we can issue a credit memo and reissue invoice. Checking ledger now.

dan_billing: I pulled INV-9443 — status: paid, amount: $12,480.00, tax: $0 (VAT-exempt). Looks like the PO field was never set on the invoice metadata. We can do credit + issue a new invoice with the PO in metadata. Need approval to create credit memo. :thinking:

alex_ops: FYI there was a webhook retry around 02:13 but that was unrelated to PO metadata. Important: when creating the new invoice, add metadata.customer_po=PO-7712 and metadata.reissue_of=INV-9443 so reconciliation matches on their side.

dan_billing: Proposed flows — pick one:
1) Refund card -> re-bill (if customer needs card-level reversal)
2) Create credit memo for INV-9443, then create INV-9443-R1 with PO metadata and apply credit to the original payment (no refund) — keeps cash in place.
If customer confirms they only need a reissue (no refund) option 2 is simplest for their AP.

karen_support: Confirmed with customer: they want a reissued invoice that contains PO-7712. They explicitly do NOT want a refund; AP will mark the new invoice as the replacement.

priya_finance: OK reissue-only is fine. Accounting note: we should keep the credit + new invoice visible in the ledger for audit. I'll add GL tag reissue_po and sign off on the credit.

dan_billing: I'll execute. Steps I'll run (will post outputs):
```
# create credit memo
billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-9443 --amount 12480 --reason "Add PO for customer reconciliation" --metadata note=\"reissue_po\"
# create new invoice with PO in metadata
billing-cli invoice create --customer SUPPLY-INC --amount 12480 --po PO-7712 --ref INV-9443-R1 --metadata reissue_of=INV-9443
```

alex_ops: When calling the billing-api include header X-Accounting-Override: true so the system allows reissue for a 'paid' invoice. Also run tax recalc for the new invoice.

priya_finance: I approve the credit memo. dan_billing you have sign-off to proceed. @maria_support please let customer know we'll reissue and will post new invoice and credit memo links when done.

dan_billing: Starting now, ETA ~30m. I'll paste the credit & new invoice links here and the ledger lines when complete.

billing_bot: Credit created: CM-5591; New invoice issued: INV-9443-R1; Linked payment id: PMT-8982. Links: https://billing.example/cm/CM-5591 https://billing.example/invoice/INV-9443-R1 (automated)

maria_support: Great — telling customer now and closing the loop. Thanks team :thumbsup:
